english.title: Open tram door otherwise than at tramstop when tram has come to a halt on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) opened a tram door on the Croydon Tramlink system at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),other than at a tramstop when the tram had come to a halt
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 11(4) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place

english.notes: Regulation 11(4) of the byelaws provides an exception to this offence:- (Save where necessary in order to facilitate an emergency evacuation), open a tram door other than at a tramstop when the tram has come to a halt.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant opened a tram door on the Croydon Tramlink system at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), other than at a tramstop when the tram had come to a halt.
